text:
marie (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — HaloEdge co-hosted APAC webinar on Apr 28. Need to lock speakers, interpreter, hw-kit routing, and run a dry-run 48h before.
aj (Events): Thanks — do we have confirmed speaker list yet?
marie (Partnerships): HaloEdge confirmed Karim + product PM. From our side: Talia can present the infra bit, Chen will cover regional GTM.
talia (DevEx): I can do infra but need translated slides (zh, ja). Who's owning localization?
chen (EMEA Sales): I can coordinate translation vendor. ETA 7 business days if we send source slides by Apr 8.
sven (Logistics): Shipping note: we need 2 demo kits to SG venue + 1 backup in JP. Carrier lead-time 5 business days door-to-door.
marie (Partnerships): Good call. Also need interpretation for live Q&A — propose Mandarin + English (simultaneous). Budget ok?
karim (HaloEdge): We can cover Mandarin interpreter on our side if Redwood covers English channel + platform overlay.
aj (Events): Covering platform overlay is fine. Who will run the interpreter audio channel? deploy-bot: rehearsal-room-2 reserved by @aj for 2026-04-26 09:00-11:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
talia (DevEx): For slides, please follow our template (light background). I'll handle speaker notes localization passes if Chen's vendor returns SRT/transcripts.
marie (Partnerships): Demo flow idea: 10m intros, 12m joint live demo (HaloEdge edge inference -> Redwood private endpoint), 8m case study, 20m Q&A. Need network and port notes.
sven (Logistics): Network reqs for live demo: outbound HTTPS to api.redwood.ai, ports 443, 80. If edge box needs SSH for remote debug, request ahead. Also we'll ship: ```- 1 demo laptop (RTX A200)
- 1 hub with wired Ethernet
- 2 HDMI -> USB-C adapters
- power strip + plug adapters```
chen (EMEA Sales): Can we get a checklist for day-of ops and responsibilities? I'll own MC and GTM slides.
talia (DevEx): I'll own the demo runbook stub and send as Google Doc. Quick snippet: ```1) boot device, 2) start local model server, 3) validate token to prod, 4) run sample prompt set```. Need someone to validate tokens before show.
marie (Partnerships): Assignments: @talia runbook + rehearsal lead; @sven shipping + on-site kit lead; @chen MC + translation vendor; @aj venue + platform overlay; Karim handles HaloEdge interpreter budget.
karim (HaloEdge): Confirmed. We'll send hardware serials and contact for on-site engineer (Min).
aj (Events): AV note — please provide exact HDMI resolution output test by Apr 20. Also need logos for stage pack by Apr 12.
marie (Partnerships): Swag plan: 150 joint sticker packs + 50 partner-branded pocket guides. Sven can confirm weight for shipping.
sven (Logistics): Estimated extra 4kg for swag. I'll add to manifest. ETA for customs forms: Apr 18.
chen (EMEA Sales): Promo plan: partner newsletter + LinkedIn co-post. I'll draft copy and share by Apr 10.
talia (DevEx): One more ask — captions for recorded video in zh/ja/en. We'll collect transcripts at end of run.
marie (Partnerships): Solid. Action items: translations by Apr 8, logos Apr 12, promo copy Apr 10, dry-run Apr 26, on-site kit to arrive Apr 23. I'll follow up with a calendar invite. :calendar:
karim (HaloEdge): All good on our side. Looking forward.
deploy-bot: reminder: rehearsal-room-2 event created (2026-04-26T09:00:00Z) — attendees: marie, aj, talia, sven, karim.
aj (Events): I'll slot 30m buffer after rehearsal for post-mortem.
marie (Partnerships): Thanks team — will DM owner assignments and upload runbook link when ready. :rocket:
